coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 18A (UCSF planned)

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (an equal-area bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B). The east extension into the former access-lane gap is an inferred fill (the block's overall outline less Block 18C and the streets), not independently confirmed as driveway/parking pavement rather than a walkway.
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary built from mapped street centerlines (trimmed against the full street width); the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

milestones.text: Same finding as 15A: the Dec 2019 map shows 18A in the 'UCSF' color; the Dec 2015 property map (LRPMP Attachment B, page 12) shows an undivided '18a' and '18' pair in grey without UCSF color-coding

changes.text: A map citation on this block no longer gives a date that belongs to the next page of the same document.

Block 18A's notes placed it west of the Owens St curve, north of Nelson Rising Lane, and back-to-back with the existing childcare building 18C. UCSF's map and our own map shape put it south of Nelson Rising Lane and east of the curve, with 18B between it and 18C. The parking-lot statement is now labelled an imagery observation, the equal-area split is described as our approximation, and the 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map.

record.notes: No building on this site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'; 'Block 18A - Research'); vehicles fill the block in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), an imagery observation no cited document states. The block is south of Nelson Rising Lane and east of the Owens St curve; in UCSF's map, 18B (future parking garage) lies between it and 18C to the east. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this block for UCSF (no use type given); UCSF's deck designates it Research. No source found for a specific project, developer, or timeline.
